title: App idea seed
description: The app ideas Mynt ships (workspaces/coding-build/templates/ideas.seed.json). They live in Postgres (financial_products.app_ideas) once an admin runs seed_app_ideas, which adds the missing ones and never overwrites a row already there. src/app-ideas.ts checks what this schema can't say: the kind exists, the lines (and categories) are the kind's, and the text promises, projects and advises nothing.

kind.description: The app kind it builds on (templates/kinds/<kind>.json)

chip_label.description: The chip's label on the Build page: 1 to 34 characters on one line, plain words saying what the app is

problem.description: Who has the problem and what it is, in plain words (the chip's tooltip)

pitch.description: One line: what the app does about the problem

goal.description: The goal the build starts from, which the developer edits

product_lines.description: Some or all of the kind's product lines

categories.description: Optional: the product categories in those lines the idea is for (within the kind's own, if it lists some); the studio picks the published products in them

product_names.description: Optional: words from the names of the products it's for (Money Market Account), when a category is still too wide; the studio picks the published products whose names contain one

sort.description: Order within the kind, lowest first
